subject: Re: HSPACE status: decision - QA gate in, outdoor scenes trimmed for v1
body:
All,

Decisions, confirming what we agreed in Tuesday's review:

1. The collision/contact QA gate ships in v1. Quality over raw frame count - 0.9M clean frames beats 1.1M with an 11% contamination rate in exactly our headline regime.
2. We trim the worst 4 outdoor scenes (the ones driving most interpenetration failures) rather than fixing them under deadline. They come back in v1.1.
3. Freeze date holds: 2026-06-08. Farah's orchestration keeps the render farm hot through then; Milan finalizes engine-export manifests the same week.

For the evaluation-server piece, that's a Q3 item and goes through Launch Review Board before anything is externally visible - I'll take the LRB paperwork.

Great catch on the placement issue, Freya. This is the difference between a dataset people cite and one they quietly drop.

Lucia
